name: Sonic / dismemberment

request.text: 4-second dry close game SFX. Immediate loud attack. A taut dry physical rupture and a sharp pressure crack, followed by a sustained pitched descending resonant ring with three weakening pulses. Audible evolving tail for 3 seconds; fade only at end. No voice, scream, music, ambience or reverb.
